facts.fact: 赴岛路程：飞机转汽车再换乘渡轮，抱怨不停的青少年全程随行
facts.anchor: first by plane, then car, now by boat, with a complaining teen in tow the entire time

facts.fact: Jessica 十五年前怀 Sandy 时正式戒烟，看船长吞云吐雾仍勾起旧瘾
facts.anchor: Jessica had officially quit smoking fifteen years ago, back when she was pregnant with Sandy

facts.fact: 渡轮甲板上只有他们家租的 ’24 Jeep Grand Manitou，Greg 和 Sandy 待在车里，Jessica 在船头与船长攀谈
facts.anchor: The deck of the ferry was empty but for the family’s rented ’24 Jeep Grand Manitou

facts.fact: Greg 在 Jessica 监督下原在伦敦机场订了紧凑型车，到店被告知没车，只能换这台巨兽
facts.anchor: Greg, under Jessica’s direct supervision, had reserved a compact car at the London airport, but upon arrival they had been informed that the car they requested was not available

facts.fact: Greg 提议趁岛上路空让 Sandy 学车，Jessica 以押金为由否决
facts.anchor: “The roads are probably gonna be pretty empty. Maybe this would be the perfect time for some driving lessons?”

facts.fact: Sandypants 在巫术论坛贴出读自 isobel gowdie 忏悔录的变兔咒语原文
facts.anchor: she had a spell for turning into a hare—“with sighing and sorrow and meckle care, I go forth in the form of a hare. And I go forth in the devil’s name, e’er that I come back again.”

facts.fact: Sandy 在学校下过 hex 的名单：Roger Jacobs、Jason Rodriguez 及两名跟班、Mr. Williams
facts.anchor: Sandy had cursed Roger Jacobs (who had pulled Sandy’s hair and called them a slur), Jason Rodriguez and two of his cronies (who had cornered Sandy after school), and Mr. Williams (who was a huge asshole)

facts.fact: 靠岛时水上立着水浸标牌：欢迎来到 HASENHURST 村，一个古朴社区
facts.anchor: a waterlogged sign announced: WELCOME TO THE VILLAGE OF HASENHURST. A QUAINT COMMUNITY.
